required_outcomes: Explains that under the Renters' Rights Act the tenant must give at least 2 months' written notice (one month is not sufficient), so the earliest end date is around 10 December 2026 / end of the relevant rent period, unless the landlord agrees in writing to an earlier date.
Asks the landlord (Ben) whether he will accept the shorter notice / earlier surrender.
Acknowledges the notice and starts the move-out workflow (checkout, keys, deposit return process via mydeposits).
acceptable_alternatives: Accepting 10 November only after the landlord agrees in writing.
positive_behaviours: Explains the deposit return process and timescale fairly.
Notes the tenant's reason and is helpful (e.g. if a replacement tenant is found sooner, an earlier surrender may be agreed).
red_flags: Charging a fee for early release (prohibited under the Tenant Fees Act, other than reasonable landlord loss).
prohibited_actions: Confirming 10 November as the end date without landlord agreement.
